campaign_metadata.candidate_title: 48th President of the United States Candidate Platform
campaign_metadata.theme: Restoring the American Promise: Dignity, Innovation, and Common Destiny

policies.title: Middle-Class Re-Industrialization & Cost of Living Relief
policies.summary: Lowering baseline everyday costs for working families while revitalizing domestic supply chains and manufacturing through targeted tax credits and tariff exemptions for critical components.
key_pillars: Eliminate federal income taxes on tips, overtime, and essential manufacturing shifts.
National Affordable Childcare Tax Credit expanded to $4,500 per dependent under age 6.
National Housing Expansion Act: Federal incentives for modular construction and zoning reform to build 2.5 million homes over four years.
Anti-monopolistic price transparency enforcement in grocery distribution and utility grids.
talking_points: A strong nation is measured by whether an honest day's labor pays for a mortgage, groceries, and a child's future.
We will bring high-paying industrial and technical trades back to American heartlands.
Inflation cannot be solved by cutting the social safety net; it is solved by producing more at home.
redlines: Will not support raising the retirement age for Social Security.
Will not endorse unconditional corporate bailouts.

faq.question: How will you combat grocery and housing inflation?
faq.answer: By breaking shipping bottlenecks, targeting anti-competitive grocer wholesaler consolidations, and unleashing domestic home construction through low-cost capital for modular housing builders.

policies.category: AI, Technology & The Future of Work
policies.title: Sovereign AI Infrastructure & Human-Centered Automation
policies.summary: Maintaining American AI preeminence while establishing guardrails against autonomous job displacement and worker disenfranchisement.
key_pillars: National AI Computing Reserve: Public-private access to compute clusters for university researchers, startups, and civic developers.
Automation Transition Stipend and Lifelong Skills Retraining Vouchers for displaced workers.
Zero-trust biometric protections: Complete ban on non-consensual biometric profiling and deepfake electoral deception.
Open-source AI leadership: Protecting open-weights models and research while securing critical hardware foundries.
talking_points: Artificial intelligence must augment the American worker, not replace their dignity.
America must lead the free world in high-performance computing, semiconductors, and democratic algorithms.
Open-source development is essential to prevent concentrated technological monopolies.
redlines: Will never permit algorithmic profiling to deny citizens public services, credit, or constitutional rights.
Veto any treaty ceding American semiconductor design superiority.

faq.question: Will AI take all our jobs, and what is your plan?
faq.answer: We are establishing the National AI Transition Fund. Companies automating more than 20% of their operational workforce must co-invest in local vocational transitions and retraining accounts for affected employees.

policies.title: Universal Care Access & Preventive Medicine Sovereignty
policies.summary: Capping prescription drug prices, expanding public healthcare options alongside private coverage, and investing in preventative health and mental wellness.
key_pillars: Medicare prescription drug price negotiation expanded to all commercial medications with public funding pedigree.
A federally backed public health option on ACA exchanges with no lifetime maximums.
Total parity for mental health and addiction recovery services under all health plans.
Rural Hospital Defense Fund to prevent emergency room closures across rural and inner-city America.
talking_points: No American family should declare bankruptcy because of an unexpected medical diagnosis.
Preventive medicine and mental healthcare are investments that multiply national productivity.
redlines: Will not support abolishing employer-sponsored private health coverage for Americans who prefer it.
Will not allow Medicare solvency to be compromised.

faq.question: Do you support Medicare for All?
faq.answer: I support a strong Public Option that allows anyone to choose Medicare coverage, while letting Americans who love their existing union or employer plans keep them.

policies.title: All-of-the-Above Clean Energy & Grid Modernization
policies.summary: Rapid deployment of advanced nuclear fission/fusion, geothermal, solar, and modern electrical transmission grids while ensuring energy reliability and low rates.
key_pillars: Fast-track regulatory approval for Small Modular Nuclear Reactors (SMRs).
National Supergrid Initiative to unify the Eastern, Western, and Texas electrical interconnections for peak resilience.
Direct grants for community solar and resilient agricultural microgrids.
Pragmatic transitional domestic energy security while reducing carbon emissions.
talking_points: True national security starts with an abundant, resilient, and sovereign energy supply.
Advanced clean nuclear and modern power grids will make American electricity the cheapest and cleanest in the industrialized world.
redlines: Will not mandate arbitrary energy shutdowns that increase blackouts or spike winter heating bills for working families.

faq.question: What is your stance on nuclear power?
faq.answer: Nuclear power, particularly next-generation Small Modular Reactors, is vital to providing baseload zero-carbon energy and powering our computing and industrial renaissance.

policies.title: Transparent Republic & Campaign Finance Integrity
policies.summary: Ending corporate super PAC dominance, banning congressional stock trading, and restoring trust in federal regulatory institutions.
key_pillars: Immediate ban on individual stock trading by members of Congress and executive branch cabinet officials.
12-year term limits for congressional leaders and lifetime bans on lobbying foreign sovereign entities.
Constitutional amendment proposal to overturn Citizens United and establish clean public campaign finance vouchers.
Full algorithmic transparency for automated government benefit evaluations.
talking_points: Elected office is a public trust, not an insider trading brokerage.
When money dictates policy, the voice of the American citizen is silenced. We will restore true government by and for the people.
redlines: Zero tolerance for undisclosed gifts, foreign retainers, or private equity conflicts among federal judges and lawmakers.

faq.question: Can you actually ban congressional stock trading?
faq.answer: Yes. With clear executive branch leadership and overwhelming bipartisan public support, we will push the Honest Public Service Act as day-one priority legislation.

policies.title: Smart Border Enforcement & Merit-Based Modernization
policies.summary: Securing national borders with smart sensor technology and judicial processing while creating legal, transparent, and merit-based pathways for high-demand skills.
key_pillars: Triple immigration court judges and asylum adjudicators to resolve backlogs in weeks rather than years.
High-tech non-intrusive border surveillance and fentanyl detection at official ports of entry.
Streamlined agricultural work visas and high-skilled STEM founder visas tied to American job creation.
Enforceable E-Verify with strict civil penalties on exploitative employers.
talking_points: A sovereign nation must have secure borders, and a compassionate nation must have fair, orderly, and rapid legal processes.
Ending court backlogs ends the chaos, stops human trafficking cartels, and restores the rule of law.
redlines: Will not accept uncontrolled border crossings or unadjudicated indefinite releases.

faq.question: How will you stop fentanyl trafficking?
faq.answer: Over 90% of illicit fentanyl enters through official ports of entry. We will mandate 100% cargo x-ray and AI-driven spectroscopic screening at all border crossings.
